rules.base_grid: 0.5 s spacing from t=0 while t <= clip_end; frame = round(t*fps)
rules.blindness: no A0/A1 ranking, no V3 support score, no OSNet identity score, no selector result is shown or stored
rules.draft_rule: Phase 10 human-assisted propagation: for an unresolved item, if the nearest earlier human box of the same dive is within 1.0s, the supported (conf>=0.05) frozen-D5 candidate with the highest IoU (gate >=0.4) is offered as a DRAFT box; a draft is never authority without explicit human ACCEPT/CORRECT
rules.eval_interval_s: [0, clip_end] (full clip; no event-GT authority exists for the new dives)
rules.extra_anchor_rule: at a base frame, if two distinct frozen-D5 candidates (conf>=0.05, IoU<0.5) have center distance < 0.1 mean-bh normalized, add one anchor at +0.25s (or -0.25s if past clip end)
